info.name: BG6 - Exports / Downloads + AP Supplier Detail

description.content:
BG6 collection. Validates the unified Exports facade and the closing AP supplier detail route:

- `GET  /api/accounting/ap/suppliers/:id` — closes the BG0 missing-route gap. Returns supplier + summary block + recentBills + recentPayments. Permission: `accounting:ap:bill:read`.
- `POST /api/exports`              — request a new export (sourceDomain=reports, reportRunId, format=CSV|PDF). Wrapped by BG3 facade (category:null, idempotencyMode:optional). Permission: `exports:write`.
- `GET  /api/exports`              — paginated history list across both `reports` and `documents` source domains. Permission: `exports:read`.
- `GET  /api/exports/:id`          — detail returning the unified envelope. Permission: `exports:read`.
- `GET  /api/exports/:id/download` — streams the artefact bytes. Permission: `exports:download`.

Unified envelope: `{ exportId, sourceDomain, sourceType, sourceRefId, requestedBy, requestedAt, status, format, fileName, contentType, fileSizeBytes, checksum, readyAt, failedAt, failureReason, downloadReady, downloadUrl, retentionExpiresAt }`. `exportId = '<sourceDomain>:<id>'`. Status mapping: PENDING→QUEUED, READY→COMPLETED, FAILED→FAILED.

Locked rules verified:
- `/api/auth/me` canonical (R14).
- POST /api/auth/login accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- New permissions: `exports:read | exports:write | exports:download` granted to Owner / Manager / Accountant. **Chef intentionally denied** — verified 403.
- BG3 facade reused for the one mutating route (`POST /api/exports`).
- No new schema (delegates to existing ExportArtifact + Document tables).
- Public diner payments still PENDING (out of scope).
- PesaPal owner-SaaS-only (out of scope).
- No hotel structures.
- Async vs sync semantics preserved honestly: report exports complete synchronously today; envelope still expresses status + downloadReady so a future async pipeline does not break the contract.

⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.** Postman caches scripts at import time.
